answer: Make every identity earn standing by publishing a verifiable garden of past work, like a sonnet that can only be written after sustained effort, with each contribution timestamped and checked by independent peers. A newcomer must first complete useful tasks under probation, and its reputation flows like a river only after consistent honest service. An attacker creating a thousand fakes must therefore pay the full probation cost a thousand times, doing real work for each, instead of copying one identity cheaply, so mass forgery becomes more expensive than honest participation.
